description: This PHP source file defines the LoggerFactory class responsible for creating and managing logger instances within the OrangeHRM framework. It primarily provides a static method to fetch or instantiate loggers with specific configurations, including log level and file path.

classes.name: LoggerFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating and retrieving logger instances with specific configurations, ensuring singleton behavior per logger name.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Returns a logger instance corresponding to the given name, creating and configuring it if it does not already exist.
